extraction.Name: Pearl Frazier
extraction.Refused/Protested: she did not want to accept it and did not want to take it, but that she understood that if she did not take the patent that the land would be sold to satisfy the taxes
extraction.Recorded patent: she had the patent recorded after she received it
extraction.Buyer: Sold to C. J. Hysham of Omaha, Nebr. for $1000 ($15.00 per acre), though she only received about $1600.00; mortgaged to Charles A. Bates of Martin, So. Dak. for $500.00 before the sale, which Mr. Hysham paid off
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she understood that if she did not take the patent that the land would be sold to satisfy the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband is a painter and during the painting season makes a good living but the rest of the year they have a hard time
extraction.NOTES: mentally sound and in good health; has a husband and five children; owns a house and lot in Gordon, Nebr. valued at about $800.00, mortgaged for $300.00; does not think she received a fair price for her land but tried to get more from several parties; Government, State, or County has contributed nothing to her support; land was not sold to pay an old debt; affidavit sworn October 30, 1928, Shannon County, State of South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Sioux" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
